newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Broadway details shr buyback, cap repayment.
newsitem.headline: Broadway details shr buyback, cap repayment.

text.p: Broadway Industries Ltd on Friday detailed a capital repayment plan, through a share buy-back arrangement, saying the equivalent capital repayment was 25 cents per existing share.
It had previously said the capital repayment equivalent was 40 cents per share.
Broadway said the share buyback would be in the form of the purchase of one share for every five shares in an offer made to all shareholders on April 28.
The shares would be acquired at NZ$1.25 per share.
The offer would be open for acceptance until 5 p.m. on May 30 and settlement would be completed during the week starting June 1.
All shares being acquired were ordinary shares and the maximum number to be bought was 3,675,148.
"The shares purchased will be cancelled. The directors advise that as the profitability of the businesses improve, they will evaluate the potential for a further capital reduction," Broadway said.
